text:
Nina (Support): Escalating to CS — Waypoint Labs trial blocked on SSO provisioning. Ticket #28290 shows 403s and rate_limit hints after a large embedding job. Renewal window ~27 days, pilot full stop.
Leo (CS): Thanks — are they a paid tier or still trial-only?
Nina (Support): Trial only, no committed ARR. Error snippet from API: {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","status":403}. Logs attached in ticket.
Ava (SE): Seen similar: huge batch+short retry windows triggers rate limit and can cause provisioning webhooks to fail. Quick mitigation: short emergency quota bump (24-48h) and ask them to run smaller batches (<=500 items). Also collect full request traces.
Leo (CS): Proposed comms: 1) Immediate outreach admitting impact + what we did, 2) Offer 48h quota bump + client workaround, 3) 30m troubleshooting session with SE + support, 4) Capture onboarding feedback for docs. Owner: Rohan to lead.
Rohan (CS Manager): Ill own outreach and shepherd follow-up. @Ivy please add any renewal/context for the email. Ill draft and post here for review.
Ivy (AE): Add a line about prioritizing the pilot and that were expediting a fix to avoid jeopardizing renewal. Keep tone proactive, not apologetic.
Nina (Support): Ticket update: "Escalated to CS. Applied +800 units quota bump for 48h as temporary mitigation. POC: Rohan." Repro curl they used: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"tenant":"waypoint"}'`
Ava (SE): Ill pull request/response traces and check timing against our rate limiter. If callbacks >8s, that explains the provisioning failures. If still failing after bump, we escalate to eng oncall.
Leo (CS): Rohan please schedule the 30m call and tag a CRM retention flag. After the call well create a short playbook entry so CS/support have a repeatable path.
Zoe (Docs): Will add a 2-line onboarding note about safe batch sizes and SSO callback expectations by EOD tomorrow.
Rohan (CS Manager): Call scheduled: 2024-07-08 09:00 PST (30m). Action items: (A) Rohan: send customer email + outreach, (B) Ava: collect traces and confirm bump applied, (C) Docs: add runbook note, (D) CS: set renewal watch in CRM and plan 7-day check-in.
Nina (Support): Final ticket note: "Customer tentatively unblocked after quota bump; awaiting scheduled troubleshooting call. If still blocked, escalate to engineering oncall."
Leo (CS): Thanks all :thumbsup: Ill keep the retention watch and post the customer-facing copy when Rohan shares.
-- end thread --
